items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: he liked both Joe and me ... in the band ... Joe is teaching me how to read

ctx.x: Ruth Fowler--- yes - and I was crazy about her - wanted to marry her and all this stuff--- and, uh, so and we sort of talked it over because that boss liked us - he liked both Joe and me - and he used to buy us drinks where he never bought anybody else in the band any drinks and he used to say to me -- okay, kid, get your coat and girl and we're going out and it might be five minutes before the show and I'd say - well, I have play -- he said, oh, forget it - they'll get along without you -- and, he'd take us out…
